text: Program Description Material forming and control engineering is the study of plastic molding and hot working change material microstructure and macro properties and surface shape in the process of the relevant technological factors on the influence of the material, solve the molding process development, molding equipment, process optimization theory and methods; The die design theory and method are studied, and the materials, heat treatment and processing methods are studied. Intership Including military training, metalworking, electrical and electronic practice, cognition practice, production practice, social practice, course design, graduation design (paper), etc., shall generally be arranged more than 40 weeks. Duration 4 years
